messages:
olivia: Heads-up — we're prepping the legal/ops checklist for the open-model redistribution bundle we plan to push to CloudMarket next quarter. Need confirmation on export classification (EAR/ITAR?), attribution language for weights, and any redistrib notices for quantized variants. cc @matt_legal @sara_ops

matt_legal: Thanks. Quick ask list: 1) who the upstream model authors are + license file links, 2) whether we change weights (quantize/convert) or serve as-is, 3) any third-party tokenizers/weights with additional constraints. I can draft notice text once we have that.

aj_partnerships: Putting together a short commercial note for the marketplace listing too — want to align on the exact attribution string so legal + marketing don't diverge. Also need to decide if we require partners to accept our redistribution addendum or if we bake it into the sku terms.

sara_ops: Ops question: do we need special packaging for Dedicated vs Hosted SKUs? i.e., for Private deployments are there extra export controls or customer attestations we should surface in purchase flow?

matt_legal: Private deployments = more customer-side responsibility, but we still need to flag export classification on the product page and in the contract. If weights are altered (e.g., INT8 quantization) that can change classification in some jurisdictions — I'll loop in export counsel.

olivia: Good call. To keep momentum, can each of you drop links and single-line answers in this thread? I'll turn them into a short checklist doc.

aj_partnerships: Draft checklist items: - upstream license + link - transformation performed (none/quantize/convert) - derived-license compatibility - attribution text (one-line) - export-class suggested label - marketplace SKU terms excerpt

sara_ops: From ops: packaging notes: - Hosted: normal listing + attribution text in UI - Dedicated: add SLA/commit language, no extra attestation - Private/on-prem: require customer export compliance attestation checkbox + pointer to redwood export guidance doc

matt_legal: Draft attribution snippet for review (feel free to iterate): `This product includes model weights derived from <ModelName> (c) <UpstreamAuthor>. Redistribution allowed under <UpstreamLicense>. Modified via quantization by Redwood Inference.` Please don't push as-is to marketplace; it's a working draft.

deploy-bot: Link posted: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/partnerships/model-redistribution-checklist (permissions: partnerships+legal) :paperclip:

olivia: Perfect. I'll consolidate into the doc and set up a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize wording before we hand to marketing. If export counsel flags anything urgent, reply here and we'll pause the marketplace cutoff. :thumbsup:

matt_legal: I'll ping export counsel now and update this thread with any constraints.

aj_partnerships: Thanks — aiming to have marketplace-ready text by EOD tomorrow.

sara_ops: Noted — will add packaging bullets to the doc and flag anything that impacts deployment templates.

olivia: closing loop: next steps in doc + quick edit pass at 10:30 PT tomorrow. Thanks everyone.
